D1 Motion and Mechanisms: practice

Booklet 5 Drive Systems · Lesson D1

← Back to Lessons

What this page practises

  • I can state what a mechanism does.
  • I can name rotary, linear, reciprocating and oscillating motion.
  • I can draw the symbol for each type of motion.
  • I can identify the motion of a part of a machine.
D1 slides (PDF) D1 slides with answers (PDF)

Warm-up

Say it the exam way

A mechanism changes one type of into another. A car wheel turning in a circle has motion. A lift moving up in a straight line has motion.

A jigsaw blade moves back and forth in a straight line. That is motion. A swing moves back and forth in an arc. That is motion.

The symbol for reciprocating motion is a line with an arrow head at . The symbol for oscillating motion is a line with an arrow head at each end.

Check your understanding

Answer in your jotter first. Then open the answer.

1. State what a mechanism does.

Show the answer

It changes one type of motion into another, or moves a force from one place to another.

2. Name the type of motion of each part: (a) a car wheel, (b) a lift, (c) a jigsaw blade, (d) a swing.

Show the answer

(a) Rotary. (b) Linear. (c) Reciprocating. (d) Oscillating.

3. Draw the symbol for reciprocating motion.

Show the answer

A straight line with an arrow head at each end.

4. State the difference between linear and reciprocating motion.

Show the answer

Linear motion is in a straight line in one direction. Reciprocating motion is backwards and forwards in a straight line.

5. Name the type of motion of a sewing machine needle.

Show the answer

Reciprocating.

Errors that cost marks

  • Use the exam word: rotary, linear, reciprocating or oscillating. In 2019, "rotating" got no mark.
  • Draw reciprocating as a straight line with an arrow head at each end (2021, 2025).
  • Draw oscillating as a curved line with an arrow head at each end (2021).
  • Back and forth in an arc is oscillating, not reciprocating: a trapeze swing (2018), a toothbrush head (2026).

Answers

Say it the exam way

(1) motion · (2) rotary · (3) linear · (4) reciprocating · (5) oscillating · (6) straight · (7) each end · (8) curved

Check your understanding

  1. It changes one type of motion into another, or moves a force from one place to another.
  2. (a) Rotary. (b) Linear. (c) Reciprocating. (d) Oscillating.
  3. A straight line with an arrow head at each end.
  4. Linear motion is in a straight line in one direction. Reciprocating motion is backwards and forwards in a straight line.
  5. Reciprocating.
